title: I am looking for that. Yes, that. Try all pockets. Handker. Freeman. Where did I? Ah, yes. Trousers. Potato. Purse. Where?
html_source: A phony distraction. The modern equivalent is taking out your mobile phone and hiding in it to avoid some social awkwardness, hence the name I’ve given it.
